issues.issue: Cluj-Napoca and the Apuseni are recognizable Romanian geography. County tourism jointly locates Turda salt mine and Turda Gorge in the local tourist geography and places the gorge on the eastern Apuseni edge. Cluj-Napoca to Salina Turda is a nearby county tourist connection, not a claim the mine is inside the city. The other routes traverse Transylvania and its1848leader Avram Iancu or the1784revolt with their Apuseni setting. Distinct geographic and historical first choices remain; their low stored salience is not obscurity. Existing neutral relationship captions make no false city containment claim.
